clips.send: A hardworking spouse sends it to their partner chasing overtime: proof money won't buy back sleep or peace - anxiety at what the grind costs.
clips.caption:
Zig Ziglar made real money long before he ever gave a motivational speech.

Then he listed exactly what that money bought him, and what it never could: a house, not a home. A bed, not a good night's sleep. A good time, not peace of mind.

He wasn't against money. He loved nice things. He just never confused having it with being whole.

Kevin Trudeau plays this clip because it's the line most people chasing a bigger paycheck need to hear.

What has money bought you that still left something missing?

#kevintrudeau #ziglar #moneymindset #wealthmindset #successhabits #mindsetshift

clips.start_words: Here's the big challenge of life
clips.send: Someone sends it to a friend who just got a windfall: a warning that cash without growth disappears - anxiety about losing it fast.
clips.caption:
Jim Rohn mentored Tony Robbins, and this is the idea Rohn built his whole career on.

Hand someone a million dollars who hasn't grown into it, and it usually disappears. Not from bad luck. Income rarely outgrows who you've become. Grow first, and the money follows and actually stays.

Rohn even said if you split every dollar in the world evenly, it would all end up back in the same pockets before long.

Kevin Trudeau calls this the real reason lottery winners go broke within a few years.

If a windfall landed on you tomorrow, would you keep it?

#kevintrudeau #jimrohn #moneymindset #personaldevelopment #wealthmindset #successhabits

clips.send: A friend sends it to someone settling for a small, safe goal: proof that aiming low still ends in failure - anxiety about wasted potential.
clips.caption:
Les Brown asked a room full of people one question: if you had your life to live over, could you do more than you've done so far? Almost every hand went up.

Then he said the line that stuck: most people don't fail because they aim too high and miss. They fail because they aim too low - and hit.

A small goal hit perfectly is still a small life.

Kevin Trudeau's take: the fix isn't trying harder at the goal you already set. It's setting a bigger one.

What goal have you kept small just so you wouldn't miss it?

#kevintrudeau #lesbrown #goalsetting #mindsetshift #successhabits #motivation

clips.end_words: let God live it in you
clips.send: Someone sends it to a friend chasing success with no real purpose behind it: the tombstone question nobody wants to sit with - quiet anxiety.
clips.caption:
Charlie Tremendous Jones once stood in a room where everyone had helped do $500 million in business that year. Successful by any measure you'd pick.

Then a man named Fred Smith asked them a question that stopped the room cold: you're not ready to live your life until you know what you want written on your tombstone.

Not your title. Not your net worth. What you actually lived for.

Kevin Trudeau says most people chase the money and skip that question entirely.

What would your tombstone honestly say right now?

#kevintrudeau #legacy #successmindset #purpose #mindsetshift #wealthmindset

clips.send: A friend sends it to someone who loves old Hollywood trivia: proof one quiet man touched Reagan, Bob Hope and Howard Hughes - pure awe.
clips.caption:
Cavitt Robert introduced himself to a room of professional speakers with a resume nobody quite believed.

Ghost writer for Ronald Reagan. Gag writer for Bob Hope. Romantic advisor to Elizabeth Taylor. The only authentic executor of Howard Hughes's will.

Then he said the one line that actually explains why people like that kept calling him: character is following through on a decision long after the excitement of the moment has passed.

Kevin Trudeau says that's the whole difference between being liked once and being trusted for life.

Which decision have you been excited about but never followed through on?

#kevintrudeau #success #characterbuilding #mindsetshift #motivation #successhabits

clips.start_words: Confessions of a Dangerous Mind is
clips.send: Someone sends it to a conspiracy-loving friend: the game show host who was secretly a CIA assassin - pure shock, has to be seen to believe.
clips.caption:
Chuck Barris produced The Dating Game, The Newlywed Game and The Gong Show. America just knew him as a goofy game show host.

Kevin Trudeau points out something strange: almost every time two people won the Dating Game, the prize sent them behind the Iron Curtain, to places like Bucharest or Belarus, instead of somewhere normal like San Francisco.

The reason, Barris later claimed, is that he was a CIA assassin, using the show as cover to slip into Eastern Europe and back out fast.

Barris always denied it afterward, laughing it off. Kevin says that's exactly what you'd expect him to say.

Do you think a game show really hid a government assassin?

#kevintrudeau #ciasecrets #conspiracy #hollywood #truestory #hiddenhistory
